title: ECLIPSE OVER SAN JUAN (FINALE)
style: Style: Epic prog finale, slow build → big climax
lyrics:
[Intro — heartbeat, ticking clock, pad]

(thump… tick… thump…)

[Verse 1]

Time keeps moving like a train
Through the pleasure and the pain
Every shadow, every flame
Calls our name

[Verse 2]

We’ve been lost, we’ve been found
Heaven hiding underground
Every dream, every scar
Made us who we are

[Pre-Chorus]

Hold on tight
Here comes the light

[Chorus]

Under the eclipse tonight
We are more than wrong or right
San Juan stars above our skin
Let the new life begin

No more fear
No more run
We are many
We are one

[Bridge — massive guitar solo + choir pads]
[Final Chorus — full band]
[Outro — heartbeat slows, ocean returns]

(thump… fade…)
